# Actuator Property Reference

Generated from the compiled `ActuatorProperties` configuration property class. Spring Boot `management.*` properties continue to own endpoint access, exposure, security, health groups, the `management.health.service-framework.enabled` health toggle, the `management.info.service-framework.enabled` info toggle, and `management.endpoint.serviceframework.access`.

<!-- generated by ./gradlew generatePropertyReferences; do not edit this file manually. -->

| Property | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `smbtech.actuator.diagnostics.cache-ttl` | `Duration` | `5s` | Duration for which one bounded snapshot or module result is shared across concurrent health, info, endpoint, and metrics readers. Set to zero to disable shared caching. |
| `smbtech.actuator.diagnostics.max-components` | `int` | `64` | Maximum component results retained in one snapshot. Accepted values are 1 through 256. |
| `smbtech.actuator.diagnostics.max-modules` | `int` | `64` | Maximum module results retained. Accepted values are 1 through 256. |
| `smbtech.actuator.diagnostics.operation-timeout` | `Duration` | `2s` | Maximum duration allowed for one complete snapshot or module-information operation. |
| `smbtech.actuator.enabled` | `boolean` | `true` | Enables the base Service Framework Actuator auto-configuration and neutral diagnostics aggregation service. |
| `smbtech.actuator.metrics.cache-ttl` | `Duration` | `10s` | Duration for which one diagnostic metrics sample is reused across gauge reads. Set to zero to refresh every gauge read. |
| `smbtech.actuator.metrics.enabled` | `boolean` | `true` | Registers bounded-cardinality Micrometer gauges when a MeterRegistry is available. |
